def VTask.nthRoot : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ
  | 0, _ => 1
  | _, 0 => 0
  | 1, a => a
  | n, a =>
    let rec newtonIter (x : ℕ) (steps : ℕ) : ℕ :=
      if steps = 0 then x
      else
        let denominator := Nat.pow x (n - 1)
        let a_div_denominator := a / denominator
        let numerator := (n - 1) * x + a_div_denominator
        let x' := numerator / n
        newtonIter x' (steps - 1)
    let approximate_x := newtonIter a 10
    let rec adjust (x : ℕ) : ℕ :=
      let power := Nat.pow x n
      if power > a then
        adjust (x - 1)
      else
        let next_power := Nat.pow (x + 1) n
        if next_power <= a then
          adjust (x + 1)
        else
          x
    adjust approximate_x
